column3: Close to the Hebrew; “antiquity I have known” is rendered “I have known of old.”
Close to the Hebrew; “conduct my case” is rendered “Plead my cause.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
Close to the Hebrew; רֹאשׁ־ (“the sum”) is rendered “The entirety.”
Close to the Hebrew; “one who finds great spoil” is rendered “one who finds great treasure.”
Close to the Hebrew; “there is no stumbling block to them” is rendered “nothing causes them to stumble.”
Close to the Hebrew; “may my cry draw near” is rendered “Let my cry come.”
Close to the Hebrew; the wishes “may my lips pour forth… may my tongue sing” are rendered as future, “shall utter… shall speak.”
Close to the Hebrew; תַּעַן (“may it sing”) is rendered “shall speak of.”
